scenarios.title: A｜询问房价、税费与押金
scenarios.setting: 在“预订前咨询 Booking Inquiries”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问房价、税费与押金”。

turns.text: Good afternoon, Grand Park Hotel. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想了解这项服务的费用，会怎么问？

choices.text: Hi, I’m interested in booking a double room. How much is it per night?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m interested in booking a double room. How much is it per night?
feedback.explanation: “interested in”表示对某事感兴趣，可以接具体爱好来展开聊天。

words: How much is the room per night?
Do I need to pay a deposit?

choices.text: Hi, what’s the rate for a double room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, what’s the rate for a double room?
feedback.explanation: “double room”通常指配一张双人床的房间；若对床型有具体要求，还可进一步确认。

choices.text: How much does a double room cost per night?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much does a double room cost per night?
feedback.explanation: “double room”通常指配一张双人床的房间；若对床型有具体要求，还可进一步确认。

choices.text: How much is a double room one night?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m interested in booking a double room. How much is it per night?
feedback.explanation: 意思清楚；报价单位通常说“per night”，比把“one night”直接放在句尾更紧凑。

choices.text: How much money a double room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m interested in booking a double room. How much is it per night?
feedback.explanation: 这里缺少谓语“is”；问价格可说“How much is a double room per night?”。

turns.text: A double room is $120 per night.

turns.prompt: 你想确认报价是否已经含税，会怎么说？

choices.text: Does that include taxes?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does that include taxes?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: Are taxes included in the price?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are taxes included in the price?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: Is that the final price?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Does that include taxes?
feedback.explanation: 这句本身自然，但“最终价格”范围较宽；如果要专门核实税费，“Does that include taxes?”更具体。

choices.text: Does that includes tax?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does that include taxes?
feedback.explanation: 疑问句已有“does”，后面的实义动词要用原形，如“include / cost”，不再加 -s。

choices.text: Do you have breakfast?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does that include taxes?
feedback.explanation: 这句问有没有早餐；当前要确认的是报价是否含税，应把问题落在“include taxes”。

turns.text: Taxes aren’t included. There’s an additional 10% tax.

turns.prompt: 你想确认报价之外是否还有其他费用，会怎么说？

choices.text: Are there any other fees?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any other fees?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

choices.text: Are there any additional charges?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any additional charges?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Is there anything else I need to pay for?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything else I need to pay for?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Have other fees?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any other fees?
feedback.explanation: 问是否还有费用用“Are there any other fees?”；不能直接用“Have”代替“有”的完整疑问结构。

turns.text: There are no other fees, but we require a $100 deposit at check-in.

turns.prompt: 你想了解退换或退款的处理办法，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is the deposit refundable?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the deposit refundable?
feedback.explanation: “refundable”指可退款的，关注款项能否退回。

choices.text: Will I get the deposit back when I check out?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I get the deposit back when I check out?
feedback.explanation: “check out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: When do I get the deposit back?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Is the deposit refundable?
feedback.explanation: 这句自然地问退款时间，但默认押金能退；当前应先确认是否可退，再问何时退回。

choices.text: Can the deposit return to me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the deposit refundable?
feedback.explanation: 押金不会自己“return”，可说“Will the deposit be returned?”；若只问是否可退，“Is it refundable?”更简洁。

turns.text: Yes. As long as there’s no damage to the room, you’ll get it back after check-out.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, thank you. That’s good to know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thank you. That’s good to know.
feedback.explanation: “good to know”表示这条信息有用，是接收建议或说明后的简短回应。

choices.text: Great, thanks for the information.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thanks for the information.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Okay, I understand it now.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thank you. That’s good to know.
feedback.explanation: 这句语法没问题，侧重说明自己现在明白了；回应对方提供的信息，也可以顺便表达感谢。

learningGoals: How much is the room per night?
Do I need to pay a deposit?

scenarios.title: B｜询问早餐、停车等服务
scenarios.setting: 在“预订前咨询 Booking Inquiries”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问早餐、停车等服务”。

turns.text: Our standard double room is $120 per night.

turns.prompt: 你想了解这项服务的费用，会怎么问？

choices.text: Is breakfast included in the price?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is breakfast included in the price?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

words: Is there an extra charge for...?

choices.text: Does the room rate include breakfast?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does the room rate include breakfast?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: Does that include breakfast?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does that include breakfast?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: Is breakfast including?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is breakfast included in the price?
feedback.explanation: 如果要问房价是否含早餐，应明确说“Is breakfast included?”；“included”表示早餐已被包含在价格中。

choices.text: Do I have breakfast?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is breakfast included in the price?
feedback.explanation: 如果要问房价是否含早餐，应明确说“Is breakfast included?”；“included”表示早餐已被包含在价格中。

turns.text: Yes, breakfast is included.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: Great. What time is breakfast served?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. What time is breakfast served?
feedback.explanation: “What time”请对方给出具体时点，适合确认开始、结束或赴约时间。

choices.text: What time do you serve breakfast?

feedback.naturalExpression: What time do you serve breakfast?
feedback.explanation: “What time”请对方给出具体时点，适合确认开始、结束或赴约时间。

choices.text: When is breakfast?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Great. What time is breakfast served?
feedback.explanation: 这句可以自然使用；“What time is breakfast served?”只是更明确地问供应时间，并非唯一正确说法。

choices.text: What time breakfast start?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. What time is breakfast served?
feedback.explanation: 询问动作或费用需要完整的疑问结构，例如“What time does breakfast start?”或“How much does parking cost?”。

turns.text: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10 a.m.

turns.prompt: 你想了解酒店是否提供停车服务，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you have parking at the hotel?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have parking at the hotel?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Is parking available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is parking available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Do you have a parking lot?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have a parking lot?
feedback.explanation: “parking lot”指停车场，是说明所在位置或约定见面的明确地点。

choices.text: Can I parking there?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have parking at the hotel?
feedback.explanation: “can / could”后接动词原形，停车这个动作是“park”；“parking”常表示停车这件事或停车设施。

turns.text: Yes, we have an underground parking garage.

turns.prompt: 你想确认是否收费、是否包含在内，会怎么问？

choices.text: Is parking free for guests?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is parking free for guests?
feedback.explanation: “free for guests”明确问住客是否免费，能把住客权益与对外收费区分开。

choices.text: Is there an extra charge for parking?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there an extra charge for parking?
feedback.explanation: “extra charge”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

choices.text: How much does parking cost?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much does parking cost?
feedback.explanation: “How much”可问金额或不可数事物的量；这里把所需数额直接作为问题重点。

choices.text: Parking is free?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Is parking free for guests?
feedback.explanation: 口语中可以用升调确认“Parking is free?”；完整问句是“Is parking free?”，电话里更不易听错。

choices.text: How much parking cost?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is parking free for guests?
feedback.explanation: 询问动作或费用需要完整的疑问结构，例如“What time does breakfast start?”或“How much does parking cost?”。

turns.text: It’s $15 per night.

turns.prompt: 你已经了解所需信息，想表达感谢并结束交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, thanks. That’s all I wanted to know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thanks. That’s all I wanted to know.
feedback.explanation: “I wanted to”在提出请求或话题时常用于缓和语气，不一定只指过去的愿望。

choices.text: Got it. Thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Okay. That’s everything for now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. That’s everything for now.
feedback.explanation: “that’s everything”表示目前没有其他需求，适合结束一次服务问答。

learningGoals: Is there an extra charge for...?

scenarios.title: C｜询问入住与退房时间
scenarios.setting: 在“预订前咨询 Booking Inquiries”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问入住与退房时间”。

turns.text: Is there anything else you’d like to know before booking?

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: Yes. What time is check-in?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. What time is check-in?
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

words: What time do I need to check out?

choices.text: What time can I check in?

feedback.naturalExpression: What time can I check in?
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: When can I check in?

feedback.naturalExpression: When can I check in?
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: What time I can check in?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. What time is check-in?
feedback.explanation: 直接提问需要疑问语序：将“can / should / will”等放在主语前；若使用实义动词，则根据时态补上“do / does / did”。

choices.text: When I can enter my room?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. What time is check-in?
feedback.explanation: 直接提问需要疑问语序：将“can / should / will”等放在主语前；若使用实义动词，则根据时态补上“do / does / did”。

turns.text: Check-in starts at 3 p.m.

turns.prompt: 你想办理入住、出行或离店手续，会怎样说明来意？

choices.text: Can I check in earlier if I arrive before 3?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I check in earlier if I arrive before 3?
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Is early check-in available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is early check-in available?
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: What if I arrive early?

feedback.naturalExpression: What if I arrive early?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: Can I early check in?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I check in earlier if I arrive before 3?
feedback.explanation: “early / late”通常放在动作短语后，说“check in early / check out late”；不要插在“can I”和动作之间。

turns.text: It depends on room availability. You can ask at the front desk when you arrive.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: Okay. And what time is check-out?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. And what time is check-out?
feedback.explanation: “check-out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: What time do I need to check out?

feedback.naturalExpression: What time do I need to check out?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: When should I check out?

feedback.naturalExpression: When should I check out?
feedback.explanation: “check out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: What time I need check out?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. And what time is check-out?
feedback.explanation: “need”后接动作时通常用“need to + 动词原形”。补上“to”，才能把“需要”和具体动作连接起来。

turns.text: Check-out is by 11 a.m.

turns.prompt: 你想了解能否延迟退房，会怎么问？

choices.text: Is late check-out available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is late check-out available?
feedback.explanation: “check-out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: Can I check out later if necessary?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I check out later if necessary?
feedback.explanation: “check out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: Is it possible to check out a little later?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it possible to check out a little later?
feedback.explanation: “check out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: Can I late check out?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is late check-out available?
feedback.explanation: “early / late”通常放在动作短语后，说“check in early / check out late”；不要插在“can I”和动作之间。

turns.text: Yes, depending on availability. There may be an additional charge.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. Thank you for the information.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thank you for the information.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Okay, that’s helpful. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, that’s helpful. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: “that’s helpful”明确表示信息或帮助有用，让对方知道这次回应解决了需要。

choices.text: I see. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I see. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

learningGoals: What time do I need to check out?

scenarios.title: D｜询问取消与退款政策
scenarios.setting: 在“预订前咨询 Booking Inquiries”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问取消与退款政策”。

turns.text: The double room is available for your dates. Would you like to make a reservation?

turns.prompt: 你想预订前了解取消政策，会怎么说？

choices.text: Before I book, can I ask about your cancellation policy?

feedback.naturalExpression: Before I book, can I ask about your cancellation policy?
feedback.explanation: “cancellation policy”指取消预订的规则，通常涉及最晚取消时间及费用；先问规则，再决定是否取消。

choices.text: What’s your cancellation policy?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s your cancellation policy?
feedback.explanation: “cancellation policy”指取消预订的规则，通常涉及最晚取消时间及费用；先问规则，再决定是否取消。

choices.text: Can I cancel the reservation if my plans change?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I cancel the reservation if my plans change?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: How can I cancel it?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Before I book, can I ask about your cancellation policy?
feedback.explanation: “How can I cancel it?”是在问如何取消现有预订；预订前了解规则，应问“cancellation policy”。

choices.text: What is your cancel policy?

feedback.naturalExpression: Before I book, can I ask about your cancellation policy?
feedback.explanation: 表示“取消”的相关规则、费用或确认时，用名词“cancellation”，如“cancellation policy / fee / confirmation”。

turns.text: You can cancel for free up to 48 hours before check-in.

turns.prompt: 关于「预订前咨询」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: So there’s no cancellation fee if I cancel more than 48 hours in advance?

feedback.naturalExpression: So there’s no cancellation fee if I cancel more than 48 hours in advance?
feedback.explanation: “in advance”表示提前；用来确认手续或通知需要提前多久，能问清时间要求。

choices.text: So I can cancel for free before then?

feedback.naturalExpression: So I can cancel for free before then?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Will I be charged if I cancel three days before check-in?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I be charged if I cancel three days before check-in?
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: So before 48 hours is no money?

feedback.naturalExpression: So there’s no cancellation fee if I cancel more than 48 hours in advance?
feedback.explanation: “is no money”不能准确表达免收费用；应明确“no cancellation fee”，并说清提前多久取消。

turns.text: That’s right. But if you cancel within 48 hours of check-in, you’ll be charged for the first night.

turns.prompt: 你想了解退换或退款的处理办法，会怎么说？

choices.text: Will I get a refund for the rest of the stay?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I get a refund for the rest of the stay?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Is the rest of the payment refundable?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the rest of the payment refundable?
feedback.explanation: “refundable”指可退款的，关注款项能否退回。

choices.text: What happens to the rest of my payment?

feedback.naturalExpression: What happens to the rest of my payment?
feedback.explanation: 问清后续处理或结果，能在行动前了解可能的影响。

choices.text: Can you return my other money?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Will I get a refund for the rest of the stay?
feedback.explanation: “other money”没有说明是哪部分款项；“the rest of the stay / payment”能明确指尚未使用的部分。

choices.text: Will you refund back my money?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I get a refund for the rest of the stay?
feedback.explanation: “refund”已经包含把款项退回的意思，一般不再加“back”；可以直接说“refund the money”。

turns.text: Yes. You’ll only be charged for the first night.

turns.prompt: 你想了解需要取消时可以通过什么方式办理，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. And how do I cancel if I need to?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. And how do I cancel if I need to?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Can I cancel online?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I cancel online?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Do I need to call the hotel to cancel?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to call the hotel to cancel?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Where I can cancel my booking?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. And how do I cancel if I need to?
feedback.explanation: 直接提问需要疑问语序：将“can / should / will”等放在主语前；若使用实义动词，则根据时态补上“do / does / did”。

turns.text: You can cancel online or call us directly.

turns.prompt: 你已经了解所需信息，想表达感谢并结束交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great, thank you. That’s all I needed to know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you. That’s all I needed to know.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Perfect. Thanks for explaining that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thanks for explaining that.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Okay, thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。
